title: CARE-SD: Classifier-based analysis for recognizing and eliminating stigmatizing and doubt marker labels in electronic health records: model development and validation
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying stigmatizing language and linguistic bias in healthcare records using NLP techniques like RoBERTa and GPT-3.5. While it mentions 'epistemology' in a linguistic context (referring to evidentials) and addresses the ethical implications of provider bias in medical communication, it is a technical study on bias detection in human-written text rather than a benchmark or evaluation of religion, faith, or formal moral/ethical systems.
